wizard.title: Run Energy Audit
wizard.subtitle: A quick path to a first audit result. You can always refine envelope, ventilation, DHW, and generation data in more detail from the building's Envelope tab afterward.

envelope.noMaterialsDescription: The materials reference table is empty in this environment, so wall/roof/floor construction can't be entered yet — an admin needs to seed it first. You can still continue and run a limited audit (envelope losses will read as zero until this is fixed).
envelope.replaceWarning: This building already has envelope data. Saving here will replace its "before" construction types, opening types, and elements.
envelope.footprintDescription: Used to derive heated floor area and volume.
envelope.windowsDescription: Window U-value is entered directly (matching the source audit methodology), not derived from layers.

consumption.title: Historical utility bills (optional)
consumption.description: Metered bills let the audit reconcile standardized estimates against actual usage. Skip this step if you don't have them handy — you can add them later.
consumption.positiveValueRequired: Enter a positive consumption value first.

run.title: Ready to run
run.description: This calculates envelope, ventilation, DHW, distribution, generation, and cooling energy use, then evaluates proposed measures — all from the data you've entered so far.
run.readyNote: Building parameters, envelope, and (optionally) consumption are ready.

endUseChart.title: Energy use by end-use
endUseChart.description: Before vs. after retrofit, final energy (kWh/yr).

energyMix.title: Current energy mix
energyMix.description: Share of final energy by end-use, before retrofit.

balanceBreakdown.title: Energy balance breakdown
balanceBreakdown.description: By component (kWh/yr) — envelope and ventilation rows are gross thermal demand before generation efficiency; final energy is what's actually purchased per carrier.

sections.envelopeVentilationLoss: Envelope & ventilation heat losses (gross thermal demand)

monthlyBalance.title: Monthly heating energy balance
monthlyBalance.description: EN ISO 13790 balance — losses, gains, and net energy need by month.

financial.title: Financial Analysis
financial.subtitle: Investment, savings, and returns per measure.

portfolioSummary.title: Portfolio summary
portfolioSummary.note: Investment, annual savings, and payback above are building-level totals from the audit engine, not a sum of each measure's own NPV below — summing per-measure NPVs double-counts shared effects and isn't a valid portfolio NPV. A rigorous portfolio NPV/IRR requires a combined cashflow, which is a backend calculation and out of scope here.

npvChart.title: NPV by measure
npvChart.description: Standardized net present value, sorted high to low.

comparison.title: Measure comparison
comparison.description: Select a row to see its full financial detail below.

shared.noMeasuresRecorded: No measures recorded for this building yet.

notRun.title: No completed audit yet
notRun.description: Run the audit for this building to generate results.
